init.title: APsystems OpenAPI options
init.description: Adjust how often the integration polls the APsystems API. The free OpenAPI quota is 1000 calls per month; the estimated usage for your current settings is written to the Home Assistant log each time the integration starts.

data.poll_pv: Poll PV production data from the cloud

data_description.poll_pv: Controls whether solar production is fetched from the APsystems cloud. Turn it OFF when the same data already reaches Home Assistant over your local network — for example from an ECU integration polling the ECU directly — since the cloud copy is then redundant and merely slower. With it off, the API is used only for battery data: roughly 60 calls per month instead of 810, and the polling interval below stops mattering. Turn it ON only if the cloud is your sole source of production data; while it is off the production and per-inverter sensors stay empty.
data_description.auto_scan_interval: When enabled, the polling interval is sized automatically to stay within the API quota. Disable to use the fixed interval below.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between API calls during solar hours (1800–7200, default 1800 = 30 min). Ignored when automatic optimisation is enabled, and unused entirely when cloud PV polling is off.
